A complete description of the sound script format is as follows:
This determines how the engine will allocate a channel to mix this sound.

determines how loud the sound is.
This is either a floating point number in the range 0 to 1, or the string
determines if and how the engine should pitch adjust this sound.

Pitch can be an interval representing the min and max pitch of the sound, or a string representing a predefined pitch
setting. A pitch of
is considered normal and the engine will not modify the sound.

specifies a single sound file to associate with this sound. They may be prefixed with a sound char, which controls
how the sound is spatialized.
determines how far the sound can be heard from.

gives more control over distance variant sounds. When a stereo wave file is marked with

blended together between the near and far distances.
